scripts.settings:web: node scripts/apply-settings.js customer && node scripts/apply-settings.js business && node scripts/apply-settings.js admin
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/apply-settings.js all && pnpm --filter @lookiva/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @lookiva/customer-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @lookiva/business-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @lookiva/admin-web typecheck
scripts.build: node scripts/apply-settings.js all && pnpm --filter @lookiva/api build && pnpm --filter @lookiva/customer-web build && pnpm --filter @lookiva/business-web build && pnpm --filter @lookiva/admin-web build
scripts.setup: node scripts/apply-settings.js all && pnpm --filter @lookiva/api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @lookiva/api prisma:migrate && pnpm --filter @lookiva/api prisma:seed
scripts.build:flutter:customer: cd apps/customer-mobile && flutter pub get && flutter build apk --release --dart-define=LOOKIVA_API_URL=http://192.168.1.120:8000/api/v1
scripts.build:flutter:business: cd apps/business-mobile && flutter pub get && flutter build apk --release --dart-define=LOOKIVA_API_URL=http://192.168.1.120:8000/api/v1
